name: 22601 · Winchester, VA
findings: ZIP 22601 (Winchester) has 196 nonprofit organizations. 85 of them (43%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 64 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (21% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 22601 (Winchester) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.
45% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: More organizations list volunteering
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 22601 (Winchester) list volunteering in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 3.0 times the typical level).
